_about: Golden-file expectations for hplc_picker. Adjudicated by Amyth against the rendered chromatograms. These are the numbers the phase-0 test suite holds the picker to. Do not edit without re-adjudicating the trace.

method2.note: Amyth: hump is a product of baseline correction. Confirmed: arPLS lam=1e5 fits 99.9-127.7 inside the span against 43-101 outside, so the fitter absorbs part of the hump and starves the floor-ratio gate. Stiffening lam does NOT recover it (see rejected_options). Manual override is the only route.
method2.verdict: record was wrong (3 peaks stands, hump span corrected 5.47 -> 7.11 min)

method4.note: 56.8 pts/min. Picker 3.0.0 was already correct; the recorded 14 was wrong.

method7.note: Shortest run in the set (4.75 min). Picker 3.0.0 was already correct; the recorded 2 was wrong.

method12.note: 41.9 pts/min. Amyth's span puts picks 8, 9 and 10 (20.06, 21.01, 21.68) on-hump, leaving 7 clean - exactly his call. Pick 9 has FWHM 1.103 min against 0.10-0.27 for its neighbours, the signature of sitting on a raised floor.
method12.verdict: record right on peaks, span widened 19.70-22.09 -> 19.25-22.39

method9.note: Amyth confirms 13 peaks including the early bump at RT 3.614 min (height 0.54). The four late peaks are 17.064, 18.548, 19.914, 21.048. Needs snr=2.5; the sweep goes 8 (snr 5.0-4.0) -> 9 (3.5) -> 11 (3.0) -> 13 (2.5, stable to 1.5) -> 17 (1.2).
method9.verdict: neither was right - record said 10, default picker said 8, truth is 13

rejected_options.stiffer_arpls_lam: Tested 1e6-1e9 on method2 to recover the hump automatically. It never finds a hump at any lam; it only finds more peaks (5 -> 7 -> 8). And lam=1e7 breaks 2 of the 15 already-agreeing traces (method1 6 -> 0, method16 6 -> 5). Default stays at 1e5.

campaign_default_snr.evidence: Tested every trace against its agreed peak count at snr 5.0 / 4.0 / 3.0 / 2.5 / 2.0. snr=5.0 gets 19/20 (only method9 wrong). snr=4.0 gets 11/20, snr=3.0 gets 5/20, snr=2.5 gets 5/20, snr=2.0 gets 4/20. Lowering the default to rescue method9 would break 15 traces. method9 is a per-run tune, not a default change - which is the sanctioned workflow: the default is right nearly always, the analyst corrects the exceptions.

status: complete - 20/20 traces reproduce their adjudicated peak count
